units: distances in Angstrom, angles in degrees, times in ns, intervals in ps

asn67_ND2.note: optional key asn67_ND2 of selections.json; the flag is 1 where ND2 is nearer to the aniline N than OD1; the orientation states use OD1 only

n2_configuration.order: e(Zn) . (e(HN21) x e(S)), unit vectors from N2

water_ring_place.note: section 9D: n_water_ring_place counts the water oxygens within water_cutoff_A of the crystal positions of site_atoms, the quantity of the hydration check of md/run_md.py

start_of_production.note: the first frame of the production (solute frame 0) against the start as built; reported only

equilibration.note: equilibration frames (solute_eqNN.dcd, full_eqNN.dcd): reported in a time series of their own, times in ns counted from the start of the production (negative); no statistic, verdict or gate of the run uses them

gate_GV.note: gate G-V of md/PLAN.md is the gate of the validation run X0 (5 ns from the crystal pose); for every other run the same numbers are given without a verdict

reported_zn_glu106.note: reported beside gate G-V (section 9C); no criterion, and not part of "passed" or of the verdict
